source_text: Klagel. Jerem. 1, 17. Σιών φησι τὸ ὄρος, τὸν δὲ λαὸν Ἰακώβ, τὴν δὲ μητρόπολιν Ἱερουσαλήμ. ἐνετείλατο δὲ ὁ θεὸς τῷ Ἰακὼβ ἐντολὰς δι' ἄς παραβαινομένας ὑπ' ἐχθρῶν ἐκυκλώθη, κατὰ δὲ Σύμμαχον καὶ καθ’ ἑτέραν ἔκδοσιν τῶν Ἑβδομήκοντα ἐνετείλατο κύριος κύκλῳ αὐτοῦ γενέσθαι τοὺς θλίβοντας αὐτόν, αὐτόν, ταῖς εἰς τὸ κακοῦν τεταγμέναις δυνάμεσιν.
pass_a_gloss: [Pass A] Zion, she says, is the mountain, and Jacob the people, and Jerusalem the mother-city. And God commanded to Jacob commandments through which, being transgressed, he was surrounded by enemies; and according to Symmachus and according to another edition of the Seventy, the Lord commanded those afflicting him to come to be round about him—to the powers arranged unto harming.
pass_b_english: Zion, she says, is the mountain, and Jacob the people, and Jerusalem the mother-city. And God commanded to Jacob commandments through which, being transgressed, he was surrounded by enemies; and according to Symmachus and according to another edition of the Seventy, the Lord commanded those afflicting him to come to be round about him—to the powers arranged unto harming (Lamentations 1:17).

choices.why: Origen pairs saving yoke of the Word with yoke of impieties / conscience in Lam 1:14.

anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of Origen’s Greek Lamentations fragments. Sense checked against Klostermann GCS III. Modern English not copied. OET = no previous English translation.
